rows.label: The Second Dream
rows.note: quest reward: built Broken War with its own slot and a pre-installed Catalyst

conditions: This is a one-time, guaranteed copy. A second copy (below) is only needed if you consume this one or want both.
bonuses: Comes with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

disclosures.title: never feed this copy into War
disclosures.body: Near-unanimous advice: this copy's free Catalyst doesn't carry over, Broken War outperforms War for most people, and replacing it can take years. Farm a second Broken War as War's ingredient instead.

groups.activity: earn a Death Mark, then stay marked for Shadow or Protector Stalker

rows.label: Broken War Blueprint
rows.note: 5.87% per Stalker kill (11.73% within a 50% table); untradeable

conditions: Stalker only spawns on missions that last past roughly 4-5 minutes: 1-minute Captures never open his spawn window.
Spawn chance is 1.5% + 0.5% per marked squad member (2% solo, 3.5% with four marked); he arrives 30s to 4-5min in.
He does not spawn in Assassination, Syndicate, Sortie, Archon Hunt, Archwing, free-roam (Plains, Vallis, Cambion), Relays, quests, Albrecht's Laboratories, Höllvania or Dark Refractory missions.
Base Stalker (pre-Second Dream) does not drop the blueprint: only Shadow Stalker (after Second Dream) and Protector Stalker (after Jade Shadows) do.
Excluded bosses grant no mark: Corrupted Vor, Ropalolyst, Zealoid Prelate, The Fragmented, H-09 Efervon Tank. Being taxied to a boss on an unlocked planet also gives no mark.
bonuses: Hyena Pack (Psamathe, Neptune) is the favorite mark farm: each Hyena can grant its own mark.
The Sergeant (Iliad, Phobos) is the fastest single-boss mark: Volt, Gauss or Titania clear it in well under a minute.
Bringing Jade in the squad skips the fight for free: Stalker says "Never", drops his loot and leaves.

About half of Stalker's kills give no blueprint at all, and Dread takes most of the rest: dozens of Dreads with no second Broken War is the norm, so treat this as a long background grind, not a session goal.

disclosures.title: beacons are a spawn fix, not a drop fix
disclosures.body: Stalker Beacons from Baro Ki'Teer (200 Ducats + 125,000 credits, stock rotates) force a spawn but still roll the same 5.87%. Expect about 17 beacons (~3,400 Ducats) for one blueprint on average. Beacon-pooling with squadmates, staggering one per mission, spreads the cost.

disclosures.title: stay marked, don't grind
disclosures.body: Keep a Death Mark active permanently and play whatever you were going to play; deliberate Stalker farming is widely described as a fast track to burnout. Realistic timelines in the community run from a first encounter to "3-4 years".
